changelog:
- Initial release of memory-to-skill-crystallizer.
- Automatically scans recent memory logs for repeated error patterns.
- Extracts and generates reusable skill files from detected patterns.
- Skill files include trigger, recovery steps, and verification checklist.
- Ensures no sensitive data is extracted—only pattern names.
- Designed to simplify reusing solutions by automating skill creation from daily lessons.
summary: Convert memory lessons into reusable skills automatically. Extract patterns from memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md and create skills/local/ entries.
